$comment: Single source of truth for every analytics event name shipped anywhere in the platform (backend track()/ingest() calls, both Flutter apps' AnalyticsEvents constants, website). Checked by scripts/check-analytics-events.cjs, which fails a deploy if code uses an event string not listed here (docs/analytics-events.json) — this is what would have caught the 2026-07-22 silent subscription-funnel rename before it shipped. 'source' is 'server' (emitted in-process via track(), never touches the gateway's /api/events route) or 'client' (sent by an app/website via ingest(), and therefore the set the gateway's /api/events allowlist is built from). Retired events are kept here, flagged retired, so historical rows remain queryable and the checker doesn't complain about old code that no longer exists.

attendance_saas_reengagement_sent.notes: attendance-SaaS wedge — nudge sent to a gym-linked signup with no booking/subscription activity

attendance_saas_bill_charged.notes: admin applied a gym's monthly attendance-SaaS bill — users joined that month x flat per-user fee debited from the partner wallet (negative balance allowed)

partner_bank_settlement_recorded.notes: admin marked a partner's pending attendance-SaaS bank settlement as paid (manual bank transfer, outside the app)

trainer_account_created.notes: partner created a gym-employed trainer account

training_session_logged.notes: trainer self-logged which attended customer booking they trained

referral_credited.notes: fires when a referred customer's first completed booking triggers the ₹50/₹50 wallet credit

attendance_slot_mismatch_confirmed.notes: fires instead of attendance_verified when a partner scans a booking's QR before its session window opens and confirms shifting the slot time

badge_earned.notes: gamification wave 1 — fires on selfCheckIn when this is the customer's first-ever attended booking at gymId

wallet_topup_config_updated.notes: admin edits WalletTopupConfig (presets/allowCustomAmount/min/max) via phool-gobhi-admin's Settings page

subscription_purchased_wallet.notes: replaces the retired two-step subscription_order_created/subscription_purchased flow as of commit b8c7251

subscription_order_created.notes: superseded by subscription_purchased_wallet; historical rows only

subscription_purchased.notes: superseded by subscription_purchased_wallet; historical rows only

referral_shared.notes: Share your code tapped on the Refer & Earn screen

map_explored_opened.notes: gamification wave 1 — fog-of-war explore map opened

session_started.notes: as of 2026-08-15, the website's copy also carries properties.channel ('direct'|'organic_search'|'social'|'referral'|'campaign:<utm_source>'), referrer_host, utm_source/medium/campaign/term/content, and landing_path — captured once at the very first paint of the session, before any client-side navigation — backing the admin's traffic-source breakdown

update_required_shown.notes: force-update splash screen shown (min version gate)

gym_image_uploaded.notes: wired to GymScreenCubit.addImage on 2026-08-17 — previously reserved but unwired since 2026-07-23

gym_doc_uploaded.notes: wired to GymScreenCubit.addDoc on 2026-08-17 — previously reserved but unwired since 2026-07-23

gym_profile_updated.notes: wired to GymScreenCubit.updateGym on 2026-08-17 — previously reserved but unwired since 2026-07-23

dashboard_viewed.notes: wired to HomeScreenTwo.initState on 2026-08-17 — previously reserved but unwired since 2026-07-23

booking_checked_in.notes: wired to CameraCubit's QR-scan verify-attendance success on 2026-08-17 (properties.method = 'qr_scan'|'qr_scan_slot_shift') — previously reserved but unwired since 2026-07-23

gym_switched.notes: SelectedGymCubit.selectGym, only fires on an actual change of selection — backs multi-gym engagement visibility, which had zero analytics coverage before this

gym_class_created.notes: new recurring-class supply feature (ClassesCubit.addClass); properties.pending reflects whether it needs gobhi approval like other gym edits

logout_tapped.notes: fires before AuthCubit.onTapSignOut/reset() so the event still carries the outgoing user's distinct_id

cta_clicked.notes: generic CTA click event, properties.cta identifies which one (e.g. 'whatsapp', 'signup')

location_resolved.notes: fires once per session after the site's silent geolocation grab settles. properties.permission is 'granted'|'denied'|'unsupported'|'timeout'|'error'; when granted, properties.nearest_gym_distance_km is the TRUE nearest-gym distance computed server-side (no 40km discovery cutoff) — backs the admin Location Reach view

offline_shown.notes: the app-wide no-internet screen was shown (OfflineGate) — how often a transport failure interrupts someone mid-task

app_error.notes: a handled client-side error surfaced to the user

sprout_encountered.notes: map collectible came into range on the Explore map

delete_account_confirmed.notes: partner confirmed account deletion. Constant is declared but not yet wired to a call site — registered so the name is reserved and the checker stays green

run_start_viewed.notes: run tracker Start screen opened — props gps_ready, has_weight (run-tracker-spec.html §13)

run_permission_result.notes: location/notification/precise-location permission prompt resolved — props kind, result

run_started.notes: recording began — props type (run/walk/cycle), gps_ready_at_start, countdown_on

run_recovered.notes: app relaunched into the "resume your run?" sheet after an OS kill/crash — props choice (resume/finish/discard), gap_s

run_finished.notes: hold-to-finish completed — props type, distance_m, moving_s, had_gap

run_upload_failed.notes: pending-queue upload attempt failed — props attempt, http_status

health_nutrition_consent_granted.notes: nutrition scope granted. props version = the privacy-policy version the client asserted it was showing, so a build that consents on behalf of copy it never displayed is visible here rather than in a support ticket

health_nutrition_consent_revoked.notes: nutrition scope withdrawn. props purged (true = the collected food logs were also deleted). A revoke is a churn signal; purged=true is the one to look at hardest

health_medical_consent_granted.notes: medical-records scope granted, independently of nutrition. No props: the words of the consent are not an analytics property

health_medical_consent_revoked.notes: medical-records scope withdrawn. props purged. Kept separate from the nutrition revoke because the two scopes are granted and withdrawn independently, and folding them together would make a partial withdrawal invisible

health_intake_saved.notes: target intake accepted. props skipped, hasGoal, weightWritten — shape only, never the values. A body weight is not an analytics property. Does NOT fire on a refusal; see health_targets_pace_rejected

health_targets_pace_rejected.notes: the requested loss pace was refused as unsafe, so nothing was saved. props code, limited_by ('max_weekly_loss_0.75kg'|'max_weekly_loss_pct_body_weight' — which bound actually fired), weeks_needed, max_weekly_loss_kg. The highest-signal event in this feature: it separates 'users ask for goals we decline' from 'users abandon the wizard', and limited_by shows whether our own cap is the constraint

health_target_recomputed.notes: targets recalculated from current weight. props written, skipped

health_food_logged.notes: food(s) added to a day. Two shapes on one event so foods-logged is a single funnel with an origin split, not two events that have to be summed correctly by hand. Search path: props slot, source='search' (one food). Saved-meal repeat path: props slot, source='saved_meal', logged_count, skipped_count — a repeat writes many foods in one request, so counting it as a single food would understate the feature, and skipped_count > 0 means foods left the catalogue after the meal was saved and the user was shown a partial-write warning

health_saved_meal_created.notes: a day's slot snapshotted as a reusable meal. props slot, line_count. A distinct decision from logging a food, and the one that predicts repeat use — a create with no later repeat is the drop-off

health_plan_regenerated.notes: suggested plan rebuilt. props created, dropped

health_day_closed.notes: a day was finalised. props frozen (false = the day was already closed, so the call was a no-op)

health_medical_doc_uploaded.notes: a medical document was stored. props kind only — never the filename, storage path, or contents; a path is a capability and the document is the user's private data
